properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (scope.rs reasoning_held_by; detect.rs is_a_reasoning_design, detect_artifact_standard, detect_closure_criterion). A Project seed's scope adds every step, what it concludes and rests on, and what objects to them, unless another Project contains them (the trolley project's region: 1 node to 85). A design with steps and nothing to build is a reasoning design also when a Project's domain names an argument, a proof or reasoning; it is not asked artifact_standard_undeclared (while no drawing or model exists) or closure_criterion_undeclared.
properties.name: A Project holds its line of reasoning, and a reasoning design is not asked a build's questions
